answer: The ledge index is deterministic from ledger replay, and therefore nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the marble queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1755 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the karst. Honest users pay that once, farms 28 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
